title: SIR in Maharashtra may have deleted 3 crore voters, claims MLA Rohit Pawar
summary: According to official data released during the SIR exercise, Maharashtra has 9.78 crore registered voters, while enumeration forms relating to 2.07 crore voters remained uncollected during the process

title: Over 2000 citizens write to CJI to stay SIR, initiate suo motu proceedings on EC conduct
summary: The letter also seeks an independent, court-monitored investigation into allegations of arbitrary, unauthorised changes made to voter registration software/forms

title: Punjab varsity students protest, block highway over unverified rape report
summary: Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP), Kapurthula, Gaurav Toora said police have no information of any such crime.

title: At UNGA, Jaishankar hits back at Pakistan PM on terrorism, Indus Waters Treaty
summary: EAM Jaishankar told world leaders that a persistent threat to peace has been the scourge of terrorism.

title: Tamil Nadu government exempts Public (Law and Order) Department from RTI Act
summary: Information on communal and caste clashes, inquiry reports on police firing, custodial deaths, details on handling of agitations by students and farmers; and all matters relating to National Security Act detentions, are now excluded from the ambit of the RTI Act

title: Palle Panduga 3.0 set to be launched to transform rural roads
summary: Ruling NDA alliance plans to mobilise one lakh crowd for public meeting

title: Suvendu claims Mamata responsible for deletion of 27 lakh names in Bengal SIR, not BJP or ECI
summary: The responsibility for the deletion of 27 lakh names lies with Mamata Banerjee, not the BJP or the Election Commission. Judicial officers took the decision following the Supreme Court's directions in a case filed by her, says Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari

title: 2024 Lok Sabha polls: DMDK’s Vijaya Prabhakaran to withdraw election petition against Congress MP Manickam Tagore’s victory
summary: The election petition had accused the then DMK Ministers K.K.S.S.R. Ramachandran, Thangam Thennarasu and P. Moorthy of exerting pressure on the Returning Officer
